title: CLO 2025.0 - Real-time Hair Generation

summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.0 - Real-time Hair Generation In this video, I will introduce the actual hair growth function. ## Introduction to Hair Growth Function In the previous version, users could only check the hair growth effect through Vray rendering. Since the 2025.0 version, the material type in the shell has increased to a new material hair growth rate. Users can directly create and check the hair growth effect in the 3D window without rendering, thereby greatly simplifying the workflow. Additionally, the hair that is based on Vray rendering can only be checked in the rendering window, which limits its use in external applications. In comparison, the hair growth rate material can lead to USD format, greatly increasing compatibility with external tools. Currently, this function can only be used in Windows systems, with support for Mac systems planned for the future. ## Setting the Hair Growth Rate Let's take a look at how to set the hair growth rate. If you want to display or hide the hair growth rate material in the 3D window, you can place the mouse on the clothing rendering option in the switch menu, and click the icon to display the hair growth rate. Then, you can use the function. At this time, the hair growth rate material will be displayed on the fabric of the hair growth rate, allowing you to check it in the 3D window in real-time. You can also click on the color of the hair growth rate randomly and assign random colors to each hair growth rate, making it easier to check the various shapes of hair growth rates. When you use a fabric with hair growth rate material, these options will be disabled and cannot be selected. ## Controlling Hair Growth Rate in 3D Window You can control the hair growth rate in the 3D window by choosing three different options. Let's go to the main menu, open the settings, then select the user definition, and click the 3D option. In the hair growth rate form, you will see three options: the original hair, the plane, and the limit. - **Original Hair**: Selecting this option will display the original hair with thickness and width, which helps to check the overall structure of the hair. - **Plane**: This option will display the hair with thickness but without width. - **Limit**: In this case, the hair is represented as a simple curve, without thickness or width. The selected option is set as default. Selecting the original hair provides a more realistic appearance. ## Applying Hair Growth Rate Material to Costumes Now let's see how to directly apply the hair growth rate material to the costume. Click on Fabric 1 in the object window. In the attribute editor, change the type of material to hair growth rate. Using the Fabric 1 fabric for the costume will immediately display the hair in the 3D window. You can select various hair types from the available options at the bottom of the attribute editor. Similar to the previous hair dye type, you can adjust the details of the attributes, such as parameters, shape settings, and default application to set the hairstyle. Here, we will quickly adjust some of the parameter values to demonstrate the working principle of hair setting. Although the hair rate and hair are dyed using the same parameters, the distribution of these two hair types is different in the hair dye window. A new random option has been added to the hair dye list. By adjusting the seed distribution value, you can create a slightly different hair arrangement, even when using the same parameters. ## Finalizing Hair Dye Effect After setting the parameters of the hair, let's open the synchronized dyeing in the hair dye window to see the final dyeing effect. You can also export the hair dye data created in the whole as a USD file and use it in other software. To do this, come to the main menu, click on File > Export, select the USD format, confirm the storage path, enter the file name, click on Save, and then click on the Export USD window. Ensure that the selection contains the hair dye data option so that the hair dye data is exported to the USD file. ## Conclusion In this section, we demonstrate a part of the hair dyeing process in the virtual engine, used to simulate a short video. In the 2025 version, the new hair dyeing material can be used to create the same hair dye as in the 3D window and the dyeing window. Additionally, by exporting the hair dye data, you can also import it into other tools, enabling its use in various creative projects. ```
